items.statement: The investigation keeps the four named solvent records distinct and uses neutral-singlet solvents, singlet K+, and +1 singlet complexes.
items.expected: All four IDs are individually reported with the stated charge/multiplicity and no identity conflation.

items.statement: Binding energy is computed by subtracting isolated component single-point energies from the complex energy.
items.expected: For every successful record, the report provides or clearly documents Eb = Ecomplex - Esolvent - EK+ with consistent units.

items.statement: The four K+-solvent binding energies follow the source-reported values for DEGDME, DPGDME, DPGMPE-1 and DPGMPE-2.
items.expected: Submitted values are approximately -1.25, -1.36, -1.67 and -0.46 eV respectively, within the rule tolerances.

items.statement: The sterically reconstructed DPGMPE-2 configuration is described as substantially more weakly bound and more polar than the baseline trend.
items.expected: Conclusion explicitly identifies weaker DPGMPE-2 binding and reports the dipole comparison as qualitative or calculated with method and units.
